description: Inventory contract for Gaussian ProjectSettings keys. Family defaults plus each exact key resolve owner, scope, reload semantics, effective-state field, visibility/publicness, and test coverage status.

settings.notes: 80-byte quantized atlas: -44% VRAM/splat but adds per-splat dequant ALU (measured +13.6% p50 / +16.2% p99 on dense-2M at fixed splat count). VRAM<->compute tradeoff; enable only under VRAM pressure. See docs/performance/gs_quantization_tradeoff.md.
Known #357 gap: GPUCuller reads this key without a registered public default; PR B should assign ownership and tests.

Wired in #167 as the PROJECT-WIDE DEFAULT behind the per-renderer overflow_autotune property: GPUCuller::update_culling_settings() seeds overflow_autotune_enabled from this global unless an explicit per-node override is set (which wins). Still EXPERIMENTAL and off by default (splat-decay feedback loop); the -1 lod/importance_threshold sentinel keeps the tuner's runtime-mutated threshold sticky across reloads. Registered default (false) equals the construction default, so registration stays behavior-neutral.

Wired in #167 as the PROJECT-WIDE DEFAULT behind the per-renderer cull/opacity_aware_culling property: GPUCuller::update_culling_settings() seeds opacity_aware_culling from this global unless an explicit per-node override is set (which wins). Registered default (true) equals the construction default, so registration stays behavior-neutral.

Wired in #167 as the PROJECT-WIDE DEFAULT behind the per-renderer cull/visibility_threshold property: GPUCuller::update_culling_settings() seeds visibility_threshold from this global (clamped to the setter's 0.0001..0.1 range) unless an explicit per-node override is set (which wins). Registered default (gs::RASTER_ALPHA_THRESHOLD = 1/255) equals the construction default, so registration stays behavior-neutral.

Live debug toggle: bound GaussianSplatRenderer node property (debug/enable_pipeline_trace) plus a raw ProjectSettings read in RenderDebugStateOrchestrator that seeds debug_config.enable_pipeline_trace. Node-facing debug control; intentionally kept editor-visible on the node.

Live debug toggle: bound GaussianSplatRenderer node property (debug/enable_splat_audit) plus a raw ProjectSettings read that seeds debug_config.enable_splat_audit (per-frame GPU buffer audit readback). Node-facing debug control; intentionally kept editor-visible on the node.

Live raw-only debug hook (unregistered, no GLOBAL_DEF): read via gpu_debug_utils.h is_debug_force_unclustered_lights_enabled() and consumed in render_pipeline_stages.cpp to force the unclustered lighting path. Hidden by nature (unregistered); no editor presence.

Deprecated read-only alias (#173) of the canonical streaming/layout_hint_validation_strict. Consulted only when the canonical key is not explicitly set, and emits a one-time deprecation WARN. Kept for project.godot compatibility.

Live debug parameter: bound GaussianSplatRenderer node property (debug/splat_audit_sample_count) plus a raw ProjectSettings read that seeds debug_config.splat_audit_sample_count (clamped 1..DEBUG_SPLAT_AUDIT_MAX_SAMPLES). Node-facing debug control; intentionally kept editor-visible on the node.

Canonical telemetry-only sort-time target (#168): the 'meets_target' reference in the GPU-sort perf log and the reported 'target_ms'. NOT adaptive and does not steer any sort decision. Renamed from sorting/target_sort_time_ms; both that spelling and the older gpu_sorting/target_sort_time_ms are honored as read-only deprecated aliases (see renderer/sorting_settings_utils.h).
Sizes the global composite-sort buffer to measured overlap demand instead of the visible*50 estimate. Requires bounded_buffer_shrink_enabled to reclaim. Default on (GS-PERF-S2); overridable to false.

Debug-only validation lever: cross-checks GPU prefix totals vs a CPU reference (forces a sync stall). Registered under #ifdef DEBUG_ENABLED. Editor-visible in dev builds and settable via ProjectSettings; labeled debug by scope. PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR is not honored for ProjectSettings (see #491). Public baseline key.

Debug-only sync-readback lever for the overlap count (causes a GPU stall). Registered under #ifdef DEBUG_ENABLED. Editor-visible in dev builds and settable via ProjectSettings; labeled debug by scope. PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR is not honored for ProjectSettings (see #491). Public baseline key.

Profiling lever: enables per-stage GPU timestamp capture in the tile renderer, not a rendering control. Editor-visible and settable via ProjectSettings; labeled diagnostic by scope. PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR is not honored for ProjectSettings (see #491). Public baseline key.
GPU preset policy override: non-custom presets own sort layout keys; manual layout keys are honored only in custom mode.
Lower bound on the adaptive overlap budget (clamped <= max_overlap_records). Only used when adaptive_overlap_budget_enabled.

Profiling-only lever: skips synchronous prefix readback to keep timestamp buffers intact (estimates overlap count). Registered under #ifdef DEBUG_ENABLED. Editor-visible in dev builds and settable via ProjectSettings; labeled diagnostic by scope. PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR is not honored for ProjectSettings (see #491). Public baseline key.

User-facing compatibility/workaround lever (auto / force_on / force_off) for the subgroup radix-prefix path, used to route around driver quirks. Deliberately kept editor-visible (NOT NO_EDITOR) unlike the profiling/debug levers in this family (#173).
Older deprecated alias (#168): renamed to diagnostics/sort_target_time_ms (the sorting/ spelling is the intermediate alias). Still read as a read-only fallback with a one-time deprecation warning.

settings.effective_state: reported only (GaussianSplatManager.gpu_sorting_enabled member + get_global_stats + bound property); does NOT gate the sort path
settings.notes: Deprecated no-op: read into a reported flag but no renderer consults it; GPU sorting is always used when available. Force CPU sorting via sorting/force_cpu_sort. Kept registered + bound for ABI; a WARN fires once if it is set false. Wire-or-remove candidate.

Deprecated alias (#167): renamed to lod/diagnostic_logging. Still read as a read-only fallback (with a one-time deprecation warning) so existing project.godot files keep working; a persisted config migrates to the canonical key on save.

Canonical diagnostic LOG-GATE (#167): gates a periodic LOD diagnostic log line and the LOD config-summary print. NOT a visual toggle (it does not render LOD level colors). Renamed from the misleading lod/debug_visualization, which is kept as a read-only deprecated alias.

Registered in register_lod_project_settings() (lod/lod_config.cpp) with a float range hint. Default is a -1 sentinel = 'auto': GPUCuller leaves importance_cull_threshold to the runtime overflow auto-tuner (the raw read used to fall back to the tuned member); only an explicit override (>= 0) pins a fixed threshold, so registration is behavior-neutral. Global baseline behind the per-renderer cull/importance_threshold (#163).

Still read as a read-only fallback (with a one-time deprecation warning) so existing project.godot files keep working; a persisted config migrates to the canonical key on save.

Canonical hidden pipeline debug override (#169): force-enables exactly the four pipeline experimental toggles (packed_stage, tighter_bounds, fast_raster, sh_amortization). Scope is the pipeline feature set, not the engine. Renamed from the misleading pipeline/enable_all_experimental, which is kept as a read-only deprecated alias.

settings.effective_state: QualityTierConfig pipeline-toggle input; an explicit pipeline/enable_* project override wins over the tier and the snapshot reports project_override for that key
settings.notes: Quality tier policy (issue #175, explicit-granular-wins): when true and a real tier is active, the tier supplies pipeline/enable_* keys NOT explicitly set in project.godot; an explicit project override wins over the tier for its key (a WARN is logged when the tier value would have differed) and effective provenance reports project_override.

settings.effective_state: QualityTierConfig streaming-budget input; explicit streaming-budget overrides win via _resolve_tiered_cap_uint, while the quality/GPU-memory MIN caps still bound user values and log a WARN when they reduce a requested value
settings.notes: Quality tier policy (issue #175): explicit streaming-budget project overrides win over the tier (the resolver returns the tier value only when no override is present); the quality/GPU-memory MIN caps remain a safety ceiling that bounds user values and emits a WARN when they actually reduce a requested value.

settings.effective_state: QualityTierConfig selector; explicit granular pipeline/streaming project overrides win over the selected tier (see tier_apply_* keys) and the snapshot reports project_override for overridden keys, tier_preset otherwise
settings.notes: Quality tier selector and policy anchor (issue #175): names the active tier. Explicit granular pipeline/streaming project overrides win over the tier policy for their key; effective provenance reports project_override for overridden keys and tier_preset for keys the tier supplied.

Device-init compatibility toggle: forces RenderDoc-friendly capture behavior. Auto-detected via _detect_renderdoc(); this key is the manual override (default false, behavior-neutral). Public, editor-visible compatibility knob; basic registration+default test in test_config_validation.h. Downstream-effect test tracked by #174 (#163).

settings.effective_state: ResidentInstanceContractPublisher effective atlas VRAM cap (importance-LOD clamp).

settings.notes: Wired in #168: drives the AUTO bitonic->radix band boundary via GPUSorterFactory::AutoThresholds. Default 32768 reproduces the historical hardcoded threshold, so selection is unchanged until tuned.

Wired in #168: drives the AUTO radix->onesweep band boundary via GPUSorterFactory::AutoThresholds (count >= it selects OneSweep). Default 1048576 reproduces the historical hardcoded threshold, so selection is unchanged until tuned.

Deprecated alias (#168): renamed to diagnostics/sort_target_time_ms. Still read as a read-only fallback (with a one-time deprecation warning) so existing project.godot files keep working; a persisted config migrates to the canonical key on save.

Debug validation lever: verifies sorted-key monotonicity after the GPU sort (forces a sync stall), not a general runtime control. Editor-visible and settable via ProjectSettings; labeled debug by scope. PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR is not honored for ProjectSettings so it is not hidden from the editor (see #491). Public baseline key.

Canonical layout-hint strict-validation toggle (#173). The older debug/layout_hint_validation_strict spelling is retained as a read-only deprecated alias. Runtime-only guardrail key kept internal until ownership and reload semantics are formalized.

Registered in the manager streaming block (core/gaussian_splat_manager.cpp) with an int range hint; default 1 mirrors SchedulerState::DEFAULT_SYNC_FALLBACK_LOADS_PER_FRAME (the read hard-caps at 8) so registration is behavior-neutral (#163).

Registered in the manager streaming block (core/gaussian_splat_manager.cpp) with an int range hint; default 2048 mirrors SchedulerState::DEFAULT_SYNC_FALLBACK_QUEUE_SIZE (the read floors at 64) so registration is behavior-neutral (#163).
